_readme: Owner-only lightsaber. Weapon is a separate prop GLB parented at runtime to a bone of owner_new5.glb. Nothing here applies to any other character.

character.supersedes: owner_new4.glb (same mesh/skin, finger weights on the RIGHT hand re-fit, +2 attach joints, +5 clips; idle/walk/run unchanged)
character.combinedFile: owner_new5_saber.glb (same, with saber already parented under weapon_R)

nodes.hilt: saber_hilt (textured PBR, metalness<=0.7, no env-map needed)
nodes.blade: saber_blade (opaque, emissive; recolour via material emissive)
nodes.glow: saber_glow (BLEND halo, optional - hide on low-end)
nodes.tip: saber_tip (empty at blade tip, for trails/light)

hand.note: Reparent node 'saber' under weapon_R with identity local transform. Grip is baked into this bone: the blade leaves the curled right fist pointing forward/up.

belt.note: hips has a -90deg X rest rotation in this rig, so these values are in that rotated frame. World at rest: pos (0.17,1.15,0.18), left-front belt, hilt hangs vertically, button faces outward. Sheathed = blade retracted.

toggle.draw: saber.parent = weapon_R; saber_blade.visible = saber_glow.visible = true; play idle_saber/walk_saber/run_saber/saber_ready/saber_slash instead of idle/walk/run
toggle.sheathe: saber.parent = weapon_back (identity local); saber_blade.visible = saber_glow.visible = false; play plain idle/walk/run
toggle.ignite: scale saber_blade and saber_glow along local Y from 0.001 to 1 over ~0.25 s (origin of both is the emitter, so scaling grows the blade out of the hilt)
toggle.ownerOnly: only load/attach this prop when the active character is the Owner

speeds_mps.note: same legs/gait as walk/run (only the right arm, fingers and, in slash/ready, the torso differ)

clips.slashNote: saber_slash is a one-shot (1.3 s); starts and ends on the idle_saber pose, so crossfade idle_saber -> saber_slash -> idle_saber.
clips.crossfade: 0.12-0.2 s between any saber clip and idle_saber is clean; do not crossfade saber_* <-> plain idle/walk/run while the saber is in hand (swap clips, they share leg timing)

rig.rightHandWeights: index/middle/ring/pinky/thumb bones now carry real skin weights (fist wraps the hilt). Left hand unchanged.
